item.title: Huntington Banker Attends National Meeting For Community Bank Leaders
item.description: Community bankers around the country gathered in Washington last week to discuss the latest challenges currently facing community banks across the country, according to Michael Zahn, president and chief executive officer of First Federal Savings Bank.

item.title: Columbia City Man Arrested For Allegedly Battering Police Officers, K9
item.description: A Columbia City man was recently arrested for allegedly battering two police officers and a K9 unit.

item.title: Marshall Declares Itself Second Amendment Sanctuary County
item.description: Marshall County has declared itself a Second Amendment sanctuary after commissioners approved a resolution Monday, Nov. 17 that took effect immediately.

item.title: Jefferson Elementary Receives KEYS Grant for STEM 3D Printing Supplies
item.description: Jefferson Elementary School's administration recently announced the school has been selected to receive a $979 grant from Kosciusko Endowment Youth Services, the youth philanthropy program of the Kosciusko County Community Foundation.

item.title: Childcare Management Company Sues Fort Wayne Church
item.description: A childcare management company has sued a Fort Wayne church over contract terms and questions of religious governance that both sides argue could determine whether a local childcare ministry remains open.

item.title: Argos Man Sentenced to 11 Years For Child Molesting
item.description: An Argos man will serve 11 years in prison for molesting a child.

item.title: Indiana’s Childcare Centers Face Funding Cuts
item.description: Indiana's childcare centers that once filled every classroom now face widespread vacancies as state support for low income families has sharply declined.
